en.title: The Shared Legacies of Nekoyanagi Bookstore
en.premise: One day, a mysterious "will" arrives at the second-hand bookstore I inherited. Rather than a list of assets, it contains humble requests: "To whom should this specific book be delivered?" Alongside a nameless cat that has made itself at home in the shop, this is a story of reconnecting lost hearts through the kindness found within the pages of books.

zh.title: 猫柳古书店的馈赠遗嘱
zh.premise: 在我继承的古书店里，某天寄来了一本不可思议的“遗嘱”。里面记载的并非财产，而是些微小的请求：“希望把哪本书，送到谁的手中。”伴随着寄居在店里的无名小猫，这是一个通过书中蕴含的温柔，重新连接错过的心灵的故事。
